hero.intro: How this website uses language preferences, analytics and external links, and how to contact us about privacy.

blocks.text: When you choose a language or dismiss a language recommendation, this website saves the chosen language in your browser’s localStorage under directive-locale. It stays until you clear the site’s storage or your browser removes it. It is separate from analytics cookies. The page language comes from its URL; a saved preference never forces a redirect. Browser language is read locally to offer a suggestion.

This website loads Google Analytics 4 to understand visits and site usage. Google’s measurement may process page addresses, referrers, device and browser information and cookies. An optional Umami tracker is loaded when configured for this deployment. Its presence is separate from Google Analytics. See the providers’ documentation below; this page does not claim that no personal data is processed.

You can clear this site’s local storage and cookies through your browser’s site-data settings. Clearing directive-locale resets the saved language preference. Blocking scripts or cookies may affect analytics or preferences; blocking cookies alone does not guarantee that all measurement stops. Google also provides an [Analytics opt-out add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout). A browser Do Not Track setting is not a verified opt-out mechanism on this site.

Hosting and delivery use Cloudflare. When you follow an external shop or other third-party link, that service handles your visit under its own policy. Some shop links contain affiliate identifiers; qualifying purchases may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. This website does not take payment details for those purchases. If you email us, your message and email address are information you provide directly.

The language preference remains in browser storage until removed. Analytics retention depends on the relevant service and account configuration; we do not state an unverified fixed retention period. Depending on applicable law, you may have rights concerning access, correction, deletion or objection. Contact us with your request; browser controls are not a substitute for submitting it. This guide covers a mature-rated game and is not directed at children. Please report any concern about a child’s information.

For privacy questions or requests, email [contact@directive-8020.com](mailto:contact@directive-8020.com). Do not send passwords or payment-card details. This notice was updated on 2026-10-22; changes will be published on this page.
